motivation: The initial within-plant-family host-identity null may confound identity effects with butterfly family phylogenetic conservatism.
operation: Double-edge swaps only when the two original links have the same butterfly Family AND the same host plant botanical family.
preserves: all native and contemporary plant geographic occurrences
each butterfly's number of hosts per botanical family
each plant's number of butterfly consumers per butterfly family
statistic: unchanged primary: distant cross-Level1 region pair climate-analogue Jaccard gain minus climatically discordant gain
test: one-sided Monte Carlo p<=0.05 and observed > null median
claim_boundary: Stricter taxonomic null still does not preserve butterfly-specific geographic opportunity counts; this is a robustness check, not independent confirmation or proof of realized trophic interactions.
stop_rule: If strict null does not pass or cannot mix, label consumer-specific evidence sensitive to phylogenetic structure, and do not claim generality.
